items.title: AMD's FSR 4.1 now works on Radeon RX 6000 cards, Xbox Series X and S, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9, and Z2 SoCs
items.description: AMD has released a version of its cutting-edge FSR 4.1 upscaler that now works on Radeon RX 6000 GPUs, Xbox Series X and Series S consoles, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9, and Z2 chips.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Earlier this year, AMD brought the previously RX 9000-exclusive FSR 4 upscaling tech to Radeon RX 7000-series graphics cards and promised an early 2027 release for RX 6000-series products. Christmas has come early for RDNA 2 and many other Radeon gamers, as Radeon honcho Jack Hyunh has announced an FSR 4.1 release for Radeon RX 6000 series cards, Xbox Series X and Series S consoles, Ryzen Z-series handhelds, and machines with Ryzen AI Max and AI 9 chips today.To accomplish this feat, AMD says it tweaked FSR 4.1's neural network model to support the INT8 shader hardware (as opposed to the higher-precision FP8 matrix acceleration hardware on Radeon 9000 cards). Additionally, the version specific to handhelds is slimmed down even further, to less than half the size of the full one.AMD says that compared to FSR 3, games on the aforementioned GPUs and APUs will now deliver better image quality, all else equal. With Cyberpunk 2077 running in FSR Balanced mode at 4K, our quick testing with a Radeon RX 6900 XT shows that running FSR 4 costs just about 13% performance, a small price to pay for sharper and more stable visuals, especially in motion.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: And the higher upscaling quality of FSR 4.1 might let gamers use Performance mode where they might previously have used Balanced, or so on, which might offset that performance cost. AMD FSR™ Upscaling 4.1 for Desktop, Laptop, Handheld and Console - YouTube Watch On There are more goodies in store, too. The Radeon team says that FSR Frame Generation now ought to have better frame pacing, resolving a longstanding complaint with the tech and potentially making for smoother gameplay with framegen enabled. Support for the Vulkan API with FSR 4.1 is set to arrive at some point, as well, a boon for some games and console emulators. Finally, AMD says FSR Ray Regeneration will also be coming to more games, too. The company showed the tech running in Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, and that integration is available now. The updated software also adds support for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Star Wars: Galactic Racer, and Final Fantasy Resonance. You can check out the full release notes here.For owners of Xbox and Ryzen Z2-series handhelds, AMD says that an update from their manufacturers will be forthcoming, as those devices depend on OEM-specific drivers.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsWe're pleased to see that Radeon gamers are getting upgrades for their existing graphics chips along the lines of what Nvidia has been delivering throughout 2025, because the way things are going, it looks like it'll be around 2077 before there will be a new gaming graphics card launch. items.titleZh: AMD FSR 4.1 现已支持 Radeon RX 6000 显卡、Xbox Series X 和
items.descriptionZh:
AMD 宣布将 FSR 4.1 超分辨率技术下放到更多现有硬件，覆盖 Radeon RX 6000 系列显卡、Xbox Series X/S 主机、Ryzen Z 系列掌机，以及搭载 Ryzen AI Max 和 AI 9 芯片的设备。此前 FSR 4 最初为 RX 9000 系列独占，今年早些时候才扩展到 RX 7000 系列，AMD 曾承诺 RX 6000 系列要到 2027 年初获得支持。如今这一时间表被大幅提前，对 RDNA 2 架构用户和大量 Radeon 游戏玩家而言是一次意外的“提前圣诞礼物”。

技术实现上，AMD 对 FSR 4.1 的神经网络模型进行了调整，使其能够运行在 INT8 着色器硬件上，而不是 RX 9000 系列所具备的更高精度 FP8 矩阵加速硬件。简单来说，INT8 和 FP8 都是低精度数值格式，前者在更广泛的旧硬件上具备更好的兼容性和执行效率，后者则在支持矩阵加速的新硬件上提供更高精度和吞吐能力。AMD 通过模型适配，让旧架构也能运行基于神经网络的 FSR 4.1。针对掌机设备，AMD 还提供了进一步精简的版本，其体积不到完整版的一半，以适应掌机在功耗、存储和算力上的限制。

性能方面，AMD 表示在同等条件下，上述 GPU 和 APU 上的游戏画面质量将优于 FSR 3。Tom's Hardware 使用 Radeon RX 6900 XT 在《赛博朋克 2077》4K 分辨率、FSR Balanced 模式下进行了快速测试，结果显示开启 FSR 4 大约带来 13% 的性能开销。对于更清晰、更稳定的画面，尤其是在运动场景中的表现而言，这一代价相对较小。并且，由于 FSR 4.1 的超分质量更高，玩家可能原本需要使用 Balanced 模式的场景，现在可以改用 Performance 模式，从而在一定程度上抵消性能开销。

除超分辨率外，FSR 4.1 还带来多项改进。AMD 表示 FSR Frame Generation 帧生成技术的帧节奏将得到改善，这有望解决该技术长期以来在帧生成平滑度方面的抱怨，使开启帧生成后的游戏体验更顺畅。FSR 4.1 还将增加对 Vulkan API 的支持，这对部分游戏和主机模拟器来说是有利消息。FSR Ray Regeneration 光线再生技术也将进入更多游戏，AMD 已在《战锤 40,000：暗潮》中展示该技术，相关集成目前已经可用。

用户可以通过 AMD Adrenalin 应用或 AMD 官网下载刚发布的 Radeon 26.10.1 驱动获得上述功能。该驱动还新增了对《使命召唤：现代战争 4》《星球大战：银河赛车》和《最终幻想 Resonance》的支持。对于 Xbox 和 Ryzen Z2 系列掌机用户，由于设备依赖 OEM 特定驱动，AMD 表示制造商将随后推送更新。

整体来看，这次更新让 Radeon 玩家能够为现有图形芯片获得类似 Nvidia 在 2025 年持续提供的功能升级。在全新游戏显卡发布节奏似乎仍较遥远的背景下，AMD 通过软件和神经网络模型适配延长了旧硬件的生命周期，也扩大了 FSR 4.1 的生态覆盖范围。对于 RDNA 2 用户而言，现在可以实际尝试 FSR 4 并评估画质与性能表现。

items.title: Mysterious AMD Zen 6 APU with 24GB of LPDDR5 memory appears in benchmarks
items.description: The engineering sample features six CPU cores, 24GB of LPDDR5 memory running at 9,600 MT/s, and an integrated GPU clocked at 2.4 GHz, although its connection to a future Steam Deck remains unconfirmed.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 6 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter An AMD engineering sample has made an appearance in a listing on OpenBenchmarking. According to a report by TechPowerUp, the chip could potentially be a part of AMD’s upcoming Gainsborough family and a possible candidate for the next-generation Steam Deck handheld console. As per the OpenBenchmarking listing, the chip comes with a six-core, 12-thread processor paired with 24GB of high-speed LPDDR5 memory.The engineering sample with part number 100-000001930-12_Y was tested on an AMD GBR-FF6-SKT validation board, with the CPU running at clock speeds of 2.4 GHz. The system also features four 6GB SK Hynix memory packages, resulting in 24GB of LPDDR5 memory running at 9,600 MT/s. That’s a big jump when compared to the current Steam Deck, which comes with 16GB of LPDDR5 memory running at 6,400 MT/s, alongside a four-core, eight-thread AMD Zen 2 processor. (Image credit: OpenBenchmarking)The benchmark listing also provides some clues about the processor’s underlying architecture. As per Notebookcheck, the sample’s CPU microcode revision corresponds to AMD’s Family 1Ah, model DCh. Linux kernel changes indicate that this model falls within the range reserved for newer Zen 6 processors, suggesting that Gainsborough could use AMD’s next-generation CPU architecture. However, there is no clarity or any confirmation whether it will use standard Zen 6 cores or the denser Zen 6C variant.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The integrated GPU is listed with a clock speed of 2,400 MHz, although its architecture and compute unit count remain unknown. The sample was tested using the GpuTest benchmark suite on Ubuntu 24.04 at 1024 x 768 resolution, resulting in scores of 3,871 in GiMark, 3,508 in FurMark, and 9,319 in TessMark. While the FurMark score is comparable to the original Stam Deck, we can’t really come to any conclusions at this point, as the tests were conducted on an engineering platform using development software rather than a finished handheld. For now, the results do not establish how the chip would perform in games, as power limits, cooling, driver maturity, and the final GPU configuration all contribute to the performance in a compact gaming device.If these specifications carry over to a future Steam Deck, the additional CPU cores along with the larger and faster memory would provide a meaningful hardware upgrade. That being said, neither AMD nor Valve have confirmed a connection between the Gainsborough family and a future Steam Deck. Thus, it is best to take this with a grain of salt and wait until there is more concrete information in the future. items.titleZh: 配备24GB LPDDR5内存的神秘AMD Zen 6 APU现身基准测试
items.descriptionZh:
近日，OpenBenchmarking 数据库中出现了一颗 AMD 工程样片，引发外界对其可能用于下一代 Steam Deck 的猜测。据 TechPowerUp 报道，该芯片可能属于 AMD 即将推出的 Gainsborough 家族，并被视为下一代 Steam Deck 掌机的潜在候选方案。不过，目前 AMD 和 Valve 均未确认 Gainsborough 与未来 Steam Deck 之间存在任何关联，因此相关消息仍应谨慎看待。

从 OpenBenchmarking 列表看，这颗工程样片编号为 100-000001930-12_Y，在 AMD GBR-FF6-SKT 验证板上测试，CPU 为 6 核 12 线程，运行频率 2.4GHz；系统配备 4 个 SK 海力士 6GB 内存封装，总计 24GB LPDDR5 内存，速率达 9600 MT/s。相比之下，现款 Steam Deck 采用 4 核 8 线程 AMD Zen 2 处理器和 16GB LPDDR5-6400 内存。也就是说，这颗样片在核心/线程数、内存容量和内存带宽上均比现款 Steam Deck 高出约 50%，若最终落地，将是明显的硬件升级，尤其有利于多线程负载、内存敏感型游戏以及集成 GPU 共享内存性能。

架构方面，报道指出该样片的 CPU 微码版本对应 AMD Family 1Ah、model DCh；结合 Linux 内核改动，该型号落在为更新一代 Zen 6 处理器预留的范围内，暗示 Gainsborough 可能采用 AMD 下一代 CPU 架构。但目前无法确认它使用的是标准 Zen 6 核心还是更注重面积效率的 Zen 6C 变体。集成 GPU 方面，列表显示其频率为 2400MHz，但架构和计算单元数量尚不清楚。该样片在 Ubuntu 24.04、1024×768 分辨率下运行 GpuTest，得到 GiMark 3871、FurMark 3508、TessMark 9319 的成绩；其中 FurMark 分数与初代 Steam Deck 相近，但由于测试基于工程平台和开发软件，而非最终掌机，且功耗限制、散热、驱动成熟度和最终 GPU 配置都会影响实际表现，目前还不能据此判断其游戏性能。

整体来看，如果这些规格最终延续到未来的 Steam Deck，更多 CPU 核心以及更大、更快的内存将带来有意义的硬件提升。但现阶段这仍只是工程样片和基准测试泄露，不能作为最终产品规格或性能结论，仍需等待 AMD、Valve 或更多可靠信息确认。

items.title: US restarts three shut-down nuclear reactors to feed AI data centers
items.description: The U.S. government is helping fund projects to bring nuclear reactors back online in an attempt to provide more energy capacity to AI data centers.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 13 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The current and expected power draw of AI data centers has been the subject of strong discussion, but today, there appears to be some good news. Three U.S. nuclear reactors are being restarted after many years offline, expected to bring 2.25 GW total to the grid. According to a report, the Palisades Nuclear Plant in Michigan, the Crane Clean Energy Center on Three Mile Island (Pennsylvania), and the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa are getting a fresh set of proverbial tires to get rolling again.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe Palisades plant was under active decommissioning, apparently marking this event as the first time a nuclear reactor is being put back to work after dismantling had begun. Despite what sounds like a tough starting point, this plant is the one that's furthest along, as it was loading fuel in August 2026 and is expected to generate 800 MW around March 2027.Much like the other projects mentioned here, the Holtec Palisades firm running the reactor took a loan from the U.S. Department of Energy. Palisades borrowed from the DoE under the Biden administration's 2024 investment in nuclear energy, while the others were issued under the purview of the Trump administration's 2025 push.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The second reactor is the Crane Clean Energy Center on Pennsylvania's Three Mile Island, repurposing the facility's Unit 1. The project started in 2024, with Constellation Energy saying it would spend $1.6 billion total for the reactor. The firm then took a $1 billion loan from the Department of Energy in 2025. Microsoft is set to be the main customer, with a 20-year contract. This facility is projected to bring 835 MW online sometime in 2027.This facility was famous in 1979 for the partial meltdown of its Unit 2, although mercifully the event had relatively tame environmental consequences. Constellation's ongoing project is restoring and refurbishing Unit 1, which didn't show significant issues until its 2019 decommissioning and has undergone a safety inspection from the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. This entity still needs to grant its blessing before the reactor starts loading fuel. The predicted output is 615 MW, with the juice expected to start flowing in 2029. Next Energy CEO John Ketchum stated that the firm was happy with its cooperation contract with Google, as it meant that "none of the costs are being paid by residential customers in Iowa."All three facilities had previously been shut down at various points as they were deemed too expensive to run, as labor and maintenance costs made nuclear-generated watts pricier than alternative means of production.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsBut the financial landscape for power has shifted, plus with such overwhelming demand and grid connections being a primary blocker for data center buildouts, their operators are likely willing to pay for premium power as long as they get it now instead of in a few decades.Some quick browsing indicates that Michigan is going to need somewhere between 1.2 and 2.3 GW for data centers alone around 2030. Pennsylvania's forecast has a wide range of 0.8 to 3.4 GW, while Iowa's range is 1.55 to 2.8 GW. These figures are loose, as they include planned capacity for data center projects that may or may not end up being built, and whose timetables may slip due to economic conditions, hardware availability, and public resistance against expansive buildouts. items.titleZh: 美国重启三座已关闭的核反应堆，为AI数据中心供电
items.descriptionZh:
美国三座已停运多年的核反应堆正在推进重启，合计预计向电网新增约2.25 GW装机容量，为快速增长的AI数据中心提供稳定、无碳的基荷电力。三座机组分别是密歇根州Palisades核电站、宾夕法尼亚州三哩岛核电站的Crane Clean Energy Center（1号机组）以及艾奥瓦州Duane Arnold能源中心。它们此前均因劳动力与维护成本上升、核电出力价格高于替代电源而被关闭；如今电力需求激增、并网接入成为数据中心建设的主要瓶颈，加上电力市场融资环境变化，运营方和超大规模科技公司愿意以长期合同锁定“现在就能拿到”的稀缺电力，即使需要支付溢价。

从技术路径看，这些项目并非新建核电站，而是利用现有厂址、主设备、电网接入和部分许可基础进行翻新重启。核电机组通过受控核裂变产生热能，驱动蒸汽轮机发电，具有容量因子高、出力稳定、可24/7运行的特点，适合承担AI数据中心的基荷需求。其创新点主要体现在三方面：一是把“退役甚至已开始拆除”的核电机组重新投入运行；二是微软、Google等超大规模科技公司通过长期购电协议直接锁定核电出力；三是美国能源部通过贷款工具为重启项目提供融资支持。与新建核电项目相比，重启可显著缩短周期、降低部分建设成本，但仍需通过核监管委员会的安全审查和装料许可。

具体参数和进度方面，Palisades核电站由Holtec运营，装机预计800 MW，报道称其已于2026年8月装料，预计2027年3月左右发电；该项目在拆除工作已启动后重启，被视为首例此类实践，并获得拜登政府2024年核能投资框架下的美国能源部贷款。三哩岛1号机组项目由Constellation Energy推进，预计投资16亿美元，并获美国能源部10亿美元贷款，装机预计835 MW，计划2027年并网；微软是主要客户，签有20年合同。该厂2号机组曾在1979年发生部分堆芯熔毁事故，但环境影响相对有限；此次重启的是2019年退役前未出现重大问题的1号机组，仍需NRC批准后才能装料。Duane Arnold能源中心由NextEra Energy与Google合作，预计装机615 MW，计划2029年供电；NextEra首席执行官表示，与Google的合同意味着艾奥瓦州居民用户不承担相关成本。

从需求和影响看，这三座机组合计2.25 GW将部分缓解AI数据中心“有算力需求但缺电、缺并网”的矛盾，并为科技公司提供长期稳定的无碳电力来源，可能推动更多闲置核电机组评估重启。但报道也提示，数据中心需求预测本身区间较宽：密歇根州2030年仅数据中心需求预计1.2—2.3 GW，宾夕法尼亚州为0.8—3.4 GW，艾奥瓦州为1.55—2.8 GW；这些数字包含可能不会落地或进度延后的规划项目，受经济条件、硬件供应和公众对大规模建设阻力影响。总体而言，核电重启为AI基础设施供电提供了比新建核电更快的补充路径，但监管审批、成本控制和工期兑现仍是关键风险。

items.title: Oblivion gamer uses Claude AI to boost average FPS gains up to 48%, stutters slashed by 90%
items.description: The new Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix mod is a pure code fix, with no changes to game assets or the game's visuals, yet it offers massive gains.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 7 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The revelation that there was a ton of performance lying on the table in the remastered The Elder Scrolls Part IV: Oblivion won't be a surprise to people who have played the game, which is notorious for its hitching and stuttering. The reason primarily lies in its poor utilization of hardware, and that's a big part of what LTSharpe and Claude have addressed in the new Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix that changes nothing about the game's visuals yet increases performance by as much as 68% in the worst case. (h/t to ComputerBase)Yes, this mod is just about 100% vibe-coded, and yet, rather than hacking Minecraft into GTA V on iPhone, or hacking CoD Black Ops 2 maps into Minecraft, this mod is a binary code modification for Oblivion Remastered that seeks to improve performance and stability considerably, and according to numerous jubilant and thankful posts on NexusMods, it seems to do exactly that, with one user proclaiming that the performance increase was "dramatic" and that the overworld stuttering that plagues the game is "completely gone." (Image credit: LTSharpe on GitHub)The story goes like this: gamer and mod creator LTSharpe has a slightly older system with a Ryzen 7 5800X CPU. Not the newest chip on the block to be sure, but Zen 3 isn't so old that it should be crumpling under the weight of games just yet. Frustrated with the verifiably awful performance of the remaster of The Elder Scrolls Part IV: Oblivion, he paid for a subscription to Anthropic's Claude AI agent and started working with the assistant to diagnose and fix the performance problems.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: "Diagnose" is a critical keyword here, because it isn't like Claude was hallucinating an engine.ini tweak somebody else published for the original game 20 years ago. The partners, with Claude doing the hard work and LTSharpe directing, reverse-engineered the game to the point that they were able to build a repeatable benchmarking framework. That allowed them to systematically diagnose the causes of the performance problems and then test fixes against the real behavior of the game with modified machine code. Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix - YouTube Watch On That's the thing; this was done without source code. Neither TES4 Oblivion nor the remaster's Unreal Engine is open-source software. The sheer magnitude of the task would be incredibly daunting to a team of human engineers, much less a single person. According to LTSharpe, over the course of two weeks Claude successfully diagnosed and fixed bugs in not only the Remaster's Unreal Engine code, but also in the underlying Gamebryo original engine, in AMD's frame generation code, and even in the Unreal Engine itself, improving performance and avoiding crashes. Indeed, he has a Radeon graphics card, which puts him within a surprisingly small minority of PC gamers, and some portion of his fixes were aimed at making sure AMD's FSR upscaling and frame generation remain in effect despite a long-standing game bug that disables them when you task-switch (Alt+Tab) out of the game. The good lieutenant invites other gamers to try out the fix and report back, and he's even helping out with support requests on NexusMods, too. items.titleZh: 《湮灭》玩家用Claude AI提升平均FPS高达48%，卡顿减少90%
items.descriptionZh:
近日，围绕《上古卷轴4：湮灭重制版》性能问题出现了一个颇具代表性的AI辅助改造案例。该重制版因卡顿、掉帧和画面停顿而饱受玩家诟病，核心原因被认为是游戏对硬件利用不佳。模组作者LTSharpe借助Anthropic的Claude AI代理，发布了“Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix”。该修复不改变游戏画面，却在最坏情况下带来最高约68%的性能提升。NexusMods上不少用户反馈提升“非常显著”，困扰游戏的开放世界卡顿“完全消失”。

这一项目的关键不在于常见的引擎配置文件调整，而是对游戏二进制代码进行修改。LTSharpe使用较老的Ryzen 7 5800X平台，因重制版性能糟糕而订阅Claude，并在其辅助下对游戏进行逆向工程。二者先建立可重复的基准测试框架，再系统诊断性能瓶颈，并用修改后的机器码针对真实运行行为验证修复效果。由于《湮灭》原版和重制版所用虚幻引擎均非开源软件，这项工作是在没有源代码的条件下完成的，难度远高于普通模组开发。据LTSharpe介绍，Claude在约两周内诊断并修复了重制版虚幻引擎代码、底层Gamebryo原引擎、AMD帧生成代码以及虚幻引擎本身的多处问题，从而提升性能并避免崩溃。

性能对比方面，该修复的重点是消除卡顿和提升稳定性，而非替换画质资源；其“最坏情况提升68%”表明原版存在大量未被利用的性能空间。新闻也指出，该模组被调侃为“几乎100%氛围编码”，即高度依赖AI辅助生成和修改，但它并非简单幻觉式调参，而是建立在逆向分析、基准测试和机器码修补之上的工程实践。

技术影响上，这一案例展示了AI代理在无源码软件逆向、性能诊断和二进制修补中的潜力：它可帮助个人开发者在传统上需要团队投入的领域快速定位问题，并为游戏模组社区提供新的优化路径。应用场景包括老游戏/重制版性能修复、AMD平台帧生成与FSR稳定性改善、Alt+Tab切换后超分和帧生成失效等长期bug的规避，以及无源码条件下的兼容性修复。不过，作者也强调，这些修改主要针对其本人系统，尤其是Radeon显卡环境，其他玩家可能效果不同；部分修复还专门确保AMD FSR超分和帧生成在Alt+Tab后继续生效。作者正在NexusMods上邀请玩家测试并反馈，同时提供支持。总体而言，该案例既说明重制版存在显著优化空间，也显示AI辅助逆向工程和机器码级修复正在降低高性能补丁的开发门槛，但其通用性、稳定性和社区验证仍待进一步观察。

items.title: China’s tech giants drop $35 billion on export-compliant Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 workstation GPU orders to power AI ambitions, according to reports
items.description: $35 billion worth of Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 GPUs have been bought by Chinese trio Tencent, Alibaba and ByteDance, with demand far exceeding Nvidia's planned production, according to report.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Chinese technology giants ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have reportedly spent over $35 billion on orders for more than 3 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 workstation GPUs. The huge order for the RTX Pro 5500, fully compliant with U.S. restrictions on exports of AI-capable GPUs to China, is reportedly far beyond Nvidia's planned production for this card. As a result, Nvidia has, according to sources who spoke to Reuters, told its customers that it isn't in a position to fill the orders as it far outstrips its planned production for this GPU.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe RTX Pro 5500 is a workstation GPU with the same number of CUDA cores as its flagship RTX 5090 GPU, but with 84GB of GDDR7 memory attached, making it a good option for AI applications. The RTX Pro 5500 is a popular choice at the moment for Chinese buyers as exporting it isn't currently restricted by the U.S. government. It's less powerful than the H200 and B300, Nvidia's AI-focused GPUs for the enterprise market, but those GPUs remain either banned or heavily restricted. As China competes with the U.S. in the race to produce newer, better AI models, GPUs like the RTX Pro 5500 continue to be indispensable.The report reveals some interesting data about the Chinese tech firms orders. Two of its sources revealed that the cards are priced at around $11,400 each, reaching a total order value of $35 billion. Meanwhile, another source suggested that Nvidia has informed its partners that it may only be able to deliver enough cards to meet between 5% and 10% of the demand. Meanwhile, Nvidia is reportedly in a position to only produce 3 million RTX Pro 5500 cards globally in 2027.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Neither Nvidia nor the three Chinese companies have confirmed any of this on the record. However, an Nvidia spokesman told Reuters that demand from the Chinese market for these chips has faced "unprecedented growth since 2022" since export restrictions were introduced. "U.S. firms continue to be restricted by a combination of outdated U.S. export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly half a decade ago, and China's own limits on U.S. imports."While trade hostility between the U.S. and China shows no sign of abating, demand for Nvidia's GPUs hasn't slowed down, despite U.S. attempts to restrict Nvidia's ability to export to China. Meanwhile, export-restricted Nvidia AI chips continue to reach China despite the restrictions, bypassing the Trump administration's efforts in the process. items.titleZh: 据报，中国科技巨头斥资350亿美元订购符合出口合规要求的英伟达RTX Pro 5500工作站GPU，以助力其AI雄心
items.descriptionZh:
据Tom's Hardware援引路透社报道，字节跳动、阿里巴巴和腾讯三家中国科技巨头据称已向英伟达下达超过300万颗RTX Pro 5500工作站GPU的订单，总价值超过350亿美元。消息人士称，这一订单规模远超英伟达对该型号的既定产量，英伟达已告知客户无法按需交付，可能仅能满足其中5%至10%的需求。报道同时指出，英伟达2027年全球RTX Pro 5500产量计划约为300万颗，而中国三家公司的单笔订单就已超过这一数量。英伟达和上述三家公司均未正式确认相关消息。

背景方面，美国自2022年起对可用于AI的高性能GPU实施对华出口限制，导致英伟达面向企业市场的H200、B300等AI加速卡在中国市场要么被禁止出口，要么受到严格限制。RTX Pro 5500目前不在美国对华AI GPU出口限制范围内，因此成为中国企业获取AI算力的重要合规替代选择。英伟达发言人对路透社表示，自2022年出口限制出台以来，中国市场对这些芯片的需求出现“前所未有的增长”，并称美国企业仍受制于过时的美国出口管制——其中甚至涵盖近五年前发布的游戏产品——以及中国对美国进口产品的限制。

从技术角度看，RTX Pro 5500是一款工作站GPU，其CUDA核心数量与旗舰级RTX 5090相同，但配备84GB GDDR7显存。大容量显存使其在AI应用中具有较强吸引力，可用于承载更大模型、减少模型切分和显存卸载带来的开销，并提升推理、微调及AI开发工作流的效率。其绝对性能低于英伟达面向企业市场的H200和B300，但在后两者对华供应受限的背景下，RTX Pro 5500成为可合规采购且显存容量突出的现实选择。报道称，该卡单价约为1.14万美元，按此计算，300万颗订单总价约为350亿美元。

这一订单反映出中国AI产业在美国出口管制下对英伟达GPU的强劲需求，以及合规工作站GPU在AI训练、推理、模型微调和开发部署中的实际价值。与此同时，巨大的订单量与英伟达有限产能之间的矛盾，意味着中国企业可能面临交付周期长、供应不足等问题，也可能推高相关硬件价格或刺激其他替代方案。报道还提到，尽管美国试图限制英伟达对华出口，受出口限制的英伟达AI芯片仍持续通过不同渠道进入中国，绕过相关政策限制。整体来看，该事件凸显了中美科技竞争背景下AI算力供应链的紧张态势，以及出口管制对产品选择、产能分配和市场需求的深刻影响。

items.title: Modal taps Nvidia Vera CPUs after firm's internal tests show 2x throughput over Intel and AMD chips
items.description: Nvidia's Vera CPU delivers twice the performance of Intel and AMD chips in AI agent workloads, Modal claims.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia has earned billions selling AI accelerators, but with the emergence of agentic AI, CPUs are going to play a considerably more significant role than before, which creates new opportunities for the company. Reuters reports that Nvidia has secured a major design win with its Vera CPUs with AI cloud provider Modal. According to Modal, preliminary evaluations showed that Vera could deliver twice the throughput of its existing AMD and Intel processors, although the company does not intend to cease using CPUs from its current suppliers.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Intel VP Robert Hallock sets Nova Lake expectations, teases return to Raptor Lake for DDR4 platformsCPU scaling with DLSSIntel's one-two punch plan in desktop CPUs is taking shapeBenchmarking AMD's BC-250, offering Steam Machine-like performance at half the priceAMD splits Zen 7 into three EPYC families for 2028 and starts selling server CPUs by the agent Modal provides cloud infrastructure that enables AI developers to deploy AI agents that can perform complex operations autonomously over extended periods. Such workloads require substantial CPU resources for software execution, data processing, and other tasks that cannot be efficiently handled by GPUs. Modal currently relies exclusively on AMD and Intel processors for these operations, but its tests indicate that Nvidia's new Vera CPUs could significantly improve performance in its specific workloads. Of course, since Vera is based on an Arm instruction set architecture, Modal's decision to adopt Vera will require substantial modifications to its software. Nevertheless, Modal believes that the potential performance improvements justify the additional engineering effort.The reported 2x throughput advantage is particularly interesting because agentic AI workloads can involve numerous independent tasks that compete for CPU cores, cache capacity, and memory bandwidth. However, Modal has not disclosed detailed benchmark configurations it used, specific AMD and Intel processor models, or performance-per-watt figures. Consequently, it remains unclear whether Vera's advantage is enabled by advantages of its Arm v9.2-based Olympus CPU cores that can decode and execute up to 10 instructions per cycle, its memory subsystem with 1.2 TB/s of bandwidth, or other architectural characteristics. Also note that tests compared Vera against currently available AMD and Intel processors rather than their upcoming generations that will compete against Vera in the coming years.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Since Modal cannot port all of its software to Arm ISA overnight, the company will continue using x86 CPUs from AMD and Intel, according to Modal chief executive Erik Bernhardsson. Rather than sticking to one ISA for everything, Modal intends to operate a heterogeneous server fleet and select the most suitable processors for each workload. Naturally, the company intends to evaluate upcoming AMD and Intel processors once they become available to make its choices in the future.For Nvidia, the agreement represents a major step toward making Vera a standalone server processor that commands a major share of the server market. The company expects Vera sales to generate at least $20 billion during its current fiscal year and estimates the potential total available market for these CPUs is approximately $200 billion. The company is on track to sell at least four million Vera CPUs in fiscal 2026. Modal expects its annual revenue to reach $1 billion within the next year. The company's service consumption has increased 3X in the last 12 months, while revenue has surged more than 15 times compared with the previous year, Reuters reports. items.titleZh: Modal taps Nvidia Vera CPUs after firm's internal tests show 2x throughput over Intel and AMD chips
items.descriptionZh:
Nvidia正在把AI基础设施的布局从GPU进一步扩展到CPU。据Tom's Hardware援引路透社报道，Nvidia已凭借其Vera CPU在AI云服务提供商Modal处取得一项重要设计胜利。Modal的初步评估显示，Vera在其特定工作负载上的吞吐量可达其现有AMD和Intel处理器的两倍。不过，Modal并不打算停止使用现有供应商的CPU，而是计划采用异构服务器队列，根据具体工作负载选择最合适的处理器。这一合作被视为Nvidia推动Vera成为独立服务器CPU、并在服务器市场争取更大份额的重要一步。

背景是，Nvidia依靠销售AI加速器获得了数十亿美元收入，但随着智能体AI（agentic AI）兴起，CPU在AI基础设施中的重要性明显上升。Modal提供的云基础设施使AI开发者能够部署AI智能体，这些智能体可以在较长时间内自主执行复杂操作。此类工作负载需要大量CPU资源用于软件执行、数据处理以及其他GPU难以高效完成的任务。Modal目前完全依赖AMD和Intel处理器完成这些操作，但其测试表明，Nvidia的Vera CPU可能在其特定工作负载中显著提升性能。由于Vera基于Arm指令集架构，Modal采用Vera将需要对软件进行大量修改，但Modal认为潜在的性能提升值得额外工程投入。

从技术原理看，Vera基于Arm v9.2架构的Olympus CPU核心，最多可每周期解码和执行10条指令，并配备带宽达1.2 TB/s的内存子系统。报道指出，Modal所称的两倍吞吐量优势尤其值得关注，因为智能体AI工作负载通常包含大量独立任务，这些任务会竞争CPU核心、缓存容量和内存带宽。不过，Modal尚未披露详细基准测试配置、所对比的具体AMD和Intel处理器型号，也未公布每瓦性能数据。因此，目前尚不清楚Vera的优势究竟主要来自Olympus核心的指令级并行能力、1.2 TB/s内存带宽，还是其他架构特性。此外，测试对比的是当前可用的AMD和Intel处理器，而非未来几年将与Vera竞争的下一代产品，因此这一结果不能简单等同于Vera对全部服务器CPU的普遍性能结论。

在采用策略上，Modal CEO Erik Bernhardsson表示，Modal无法在一夜之间将所有软件移植到Arm ISA，因此将继续使用AMD和Intel的x86 CPU。Modal计划运营异构服务器队列，而不是让所有工作负载统一使用一种指令集架构，并会针对每类工作负载选择最合适的处理器。未来，Modal还打算在AMD和Intel新品上市后进行评估，以决定后续选择。对Nvidia而言，这项协议是其让Vera成为独立服务器处理器并占据服务器市场重要份额的关键进展。Nvidia预计Vera在当前财年将带来至少200亿美元销售额，并估计这些CPU的潜在总可服务市场（TAM）约为2000亿美元；公司还计划在2026财年销售至少400万颗Vera CPU。

这一消息也发生在Modal完成7.5亿美元融资之后。该轮融资由Accel领投，对Modal的估值为157.5亿美元。Modal预计其年收入将在未来一年内达到10亿美元；路透社报道称，过去12个月Modal的服务消费增长了3倍，收入同比增长超过15倍。整体来看，Vera在Modal的落地展示了智能体AI时代CPU资源的重要性上升，也反映出Nvidia正试图在GPU之外建立新的服务器CPU增长曲线；但Arm软件生态迁移成本、基准测试透明度以及未来AMD/Intel产品的竞争，仍是评估Vera实际竞争力的关键变量。

items.title: Intel asks FCC for waiver to buy foreign robots
items.description: Intel is concerned that the sweeping ban on foreign-made robots means that it could not update or maintain its fleet of AGVs.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Intel has asked the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to make an exception for the automated guided vehicles (AGVs) that the company uses to transport the sensitive silicon wafers and other materials, containers, and supplies needed to make the most advanced chips in its fabs. According to Bloomberg, the American chipmaker fears that its AGVs would fall under the blanket prohibition against foreign-made robots after they were added to the FCC’s Covered List.Go deeper with TH Premium: Chipmaking (Image credit: tsmc)Analyzing TSMC's fab expansion roadmap — multi-fab N2 ramp, CoWoS, SoIC, and uncorking bottlenecksLeading-edge foundry roadmaps for TSMC, Intel, and SamsungASML's roadmap for chipmaking lithography tools examinedChinese chipmaking tool roadmaps examinedAGVs are niche machines that chip fabs use to transport materials and supplies between tools and sections of the fab, helping ensure that the cleanroom conditions required for each manufacturing process are maintained. This makes them critical equipment for U.S. semiconductor manufacturing, but, apparently, there are no suitable domestic alternatives for these devices at the moment. Intel’s current fleet of AGVs requires continuous maintenance, including software and firmware updates, and if it’s forced to find a local supplier for its AGVs, the company says that it would take years, crippling the United States’ chipmaking efforts.The biggest AGV suppliers are Japanese companies like Murata Machinery and Daifuku Co., while a few smaller businesses from South Korea and Taiwan are also trying to break into the market. It’s unclear why these companies haven’t applied for a conditional approval yet, which would allow them to continue selling these products in the U.S. while also promising Washington that they’ll set up a manufacturing base in the country. This is something that Netgear has already done, allowing it to continue selling its foreign-made routers despite being an American company.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Intel says that it remains unclear if updates to its AGVs would break compliance with the FCC, and that it’s asking the agency to issue a conditional waiver “out of an abundance of caution to ensure the ongoing operation of these specific AGV units.” While Team Blue is the only company concerned about AGVs at the moment, other chip manufacturers would likely need a similar waiver in the near future, especially as they build more fabs in the U.S. This includes TSMC, which is planning to build 12 more fabs and four packaging facilities in Arizona, Samsung, with its new Taylor, Texas, fab, and even Elon Musk’s Terafab, which has already begun construction.Washington has been using the FCC to force companies to invest in American manufacturing. Its blanket bans on foreign-made products like drones and routers have affected some of the biggest brands in the U.S., including DJI and TP-Link. While these bans do not outright ban the sale of all products made by these companies, especially those that have already been approved before, they make it impossible for them to introduce new products and even release software updates to their existing product line. items.titleZh: 英特尔请求FCC豁免以购买外国机器人
items.descriptionZh:
英特尔已向美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）提出申请，希望为其晶圆厂内使用的自动导引车（AGV）争取有条件豁免，使其不受到FCC“覆盖清单”中对外国制造机器人禁令的影响。背景是，FCC已将外国制造机器人纳入“覆盖清单”，可能形成全面禁止进口或使用相关产品的效果。英特尔担心，其用于搬运硅晶圆、材料、容器和生产耗材的AGV会被纳入禁令范围，从而影响其最先进芯片制造业务的正常运行。

AGV是晶圆厂中的利基但关键设备，主要用于在制造工具、工段和洁净室区域之间运输敏感材料与供应品。其核心作用不仅是自动化物流，还在于减少人工介入、维持洁净室环境、降低污染风险，并保证不同制造工序所需的洁净条件。因此，AGV被视为美国半导体制造的重要基础设施。但报道指出，目前美国国内并没有合适的替代产品。英特尔现有AGV车队需要持续维护，包括软件和固件更新；如果被迫寻找本土供应商，英特尔称可能需要数年时间，这将拖累美国芯片制造能力。

从供应链看，全球最大AGV供应商包括日本村田机械和Daifuku，韩国和台湾地区的一些较小企业也在尝试进入该市场。报道未披露AGV的具体速度、负载、精度等性能参数，也未提供进口与本土设备的量化对比数据；核心对比在于替代周期和供应链成熟度：英特尔认为本土替代需要数年，而现有外国设备已深度嵌入其晶圆厂运营。报道还提到，目前不清楚这些外国供应商为何尚未申请有条件批准。该机制允许企业继续在美国销售相关产品，同时承诺在美国建立制造基地；Netgear此前已通过类似方式继续销售外国制造的路由器。

英特尔表示，目前尚不确定对AGV进行软件或固件更新是否会违反FCC合规要求，因此请求FCC“出于充分谨慎”发布有条件豁免，以确保这些特定AGV单元持续运行。虽然目前公开表达担忧的只有英特尔，但其他在美国扩产的芯片制造商未来也可能需要类似豁免。例如，台积电计划在亚利桑那州再建12座晶圆厂和4座封装设施，三星在得克萨斯州Taylor建设新晶圆厂，马斯克的Terafab也已开始建设。这些项目都将依赖大量洁净室物流自动化设备。

这一事件也反映出华盛顿正通过FCC等监管工具推动制造业回流。此前，FCC对外国制造无人机和路由器的全面限制已影响大疆、TP-Link等大型品牌。此类禁令并非一概禁止所有已获批产品的销售，但会使企业难以推出新产品，并可能影响现有产品线的软件更新。FCC后来撤回了软件更新禁令，但企业若不将生产迁至美国，仍无法注册新产品。对半导体行业而言，AGV豁免问题不仅关乎单一设备合规，还关系到先进晶圆厂扩产进度、洁净室物流自动化连续性和美国芯片制造供应链的稳定性。

items.title: Windows 98 SE users get a Thunderbolt 4 driver, thanks to AI assistance
items.description: Windows 98 devotees now have (experimental) support for USB4 and Thunderbolt 3/4. Vibe coded driver also supports Windows Me, XP, Vista, and 7.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 6 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Windows 98 SE devotees can now enjoy (experimental) support for USB4 and Thunderbolt 3/4. Developer and maker Yeo Kheng Meng, who also enjoys retrocomputing, recently released the vibe-coded xHCI98 v3.0.0.0, enabling the practical use of generic USB 3.x, USB4, and Thunderbolt 3/4 host controllers on systems running Windows 98 SE, ME, 2000, XP, Vista, and 7. An extensive blog post by the dev provides further reading about the driver, compatibility, its creation, and usage. xHCI98: xHCI host controller driver for Win 98/ME/2K/XP/Vista/7 Demo - YouTube Watch On Demo video “shows many different USB devices being hotplugged to a modern 2020 ThinkPad P14s Gen 1 with only xHCI controller.”Some of you will be wondering why a project to bring USB4 (Thunderbolt 3 and 4) to PCs running Windows 98 SE exists. Retro computing fan Meng explains on his GitHub that this project should appeal directly to users of PCs from the mid-2010s that have xHCI-only (USB 3.x) chipsets and no legacy EHCI controller. However, older OSes don’t have xHCI drivers, and that’s where xHCI98 steps in. “Without xHCI support, even keyboards, mice, and flash drives need the BIOS's legacy support, cannot be hotplugged, and devices such as Ethernet and audio do not work at all,” explains Meng, revealing his motivation. “This project fills that gap.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Impressively, xHCI98 drives a lot more than USB storage. It replaces Windows’ own USB port and hub drivers to facilitate the connection and use of USB 1.1 and 2.0 and SuperSpeed (USB 3.x) devices and hubs, UAS (USB Attached SCSI) storage through a second driver (xhciuas.sys), and Thunderbolt 3 and USB4 docks and NVMe enclosures through a third driver (xhcicm.sys).Meng has developed and tested xHCI98 mostly on Intel hardware, as that is what he owns. Candidly, he admits “this is a solo human's project with AI assistance, so bugs are not unexpected,” even if you do have the same hardware as the dev - a 2020 ThinkPad P14s Gen 1 (Comet Lake xHCI, no EHCI). It stands up pretty well during the plug/unplug video demo above, though the test rig used is not quite the USB cart of death. You may like Modder brings Nvidia Pascal GPU support to Windows XP 32-bit Developer uses Claude to vibe code a Windows 3.1 shell in an hour x64 port of Microsoft Word for Windows 1.1a arrives (Image credit: Yeo Kheng Meng)As a solo developer, Meng isn't shy to admit he leaned heavily on AI assistance to prepare the xHCI98 release. His vibe coding adventure was supported by Claude Fable 5.1 for planning, Claude Opus 5.5 for coding, and Codex GPT 6 Astra as an adversarial reviewer.In addition to a few bug warnings, there are some other things to know about using this driver with the various older versions of Windows it supports, standby and hibernation, and more. The dev helpfully sketches out a process for checking your hardware, outlines various install methods, discusses updating, and talks about tuning the driver for those who will be jumping in at the deep end with this project.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.

items.titleZh: Windows 98 SE 用户获得 Thunderbolt 4 驱动，得益于 AI 协助
items.descriptionZh:
复古计算开发者 Yeo Kheng Meng 发布了实验性的 xHCI98 v3.0.0.0 驱动，为 Windows 98 SE、ME、2000、XP、Vista 和 7 提供 xHCI 主机控制器支持，使这些老系统能够在仅配备 xHCI（USB 3.x）控制器、没有传统 EHCI 控制器的较新硬件上，实际使用通用 USB 3.x、USB4 以及 Thunderbolt 3/4 主机控制器。项目背景是：2010 年代中期以后的 PC 芯片组普遍采用 xHCI-only 设计，但旧版 Windows 不包含 xHCI 驱动，导致键盘、鼠标和闪存盘只能依赖 BIOS 的 legacy 兼容支持，无法热插拔，以太网、音频等设备甚至完全无法工作。xHCI98 正是为填补这一空白而开发。

在技术实现上，xHCI98 替代 Windows 自带的 USB 端口和 Hub 驱动，支持 USB 1.1、USB 2.0 和 SuperSpeed USB 3.x 设备及 Hub；通过第二个驱动 xhciuas.sys 支持 UAS（USB Attached SCSI）存储；通过第三个驱动 xhcicm.sys 支持 Thunderbolt 3/USB4 扩展坞和 NVMe 外置硬盘盒。开发者主要在自有的 Intel 硬件上开发和测试，典型平台为 2020 款 ThinkPad P14s Gen 1（Comet Lake xHCI，无 EHCI）。演示视频显示，多种 USB 设备可在该平台上热插拔使用。

该项目由单人开发并大量借助 AI 辅助完成，开发者坦言“这是一个人加 AI 协助的项目，出现 bug 并不意外”。其 AI 工具组合包括 Claude Fable 5.1 用于规划、Claude Opus 5.5 用于编码、Codex GPT 6 Astra 作为对抗性审查者。文章未给出量化性能基准，主要价值体现在兼容性和功能恢复：让旧操作系统重新获得现代 USB 控制器下的热插拔、存储、扩展坞和 NVMe 外设能力。该驱动目前属于实验性支持，适合复古计算、旧设备维护和特定遗留系统场景，但不应视为生产级驱动；使用前需核对硬件兼容性，并参考开发者博客中的安装、更新、待机/休眠注意事项和调优说明。

items.title: Spain-Based Startups Advance Regional Innovation With Barcelona Supercomputing Center
items.description: The Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC)’s AI Factory Accelerator Programme, now in full operation following a pilot initiative, gives startups access to sovereign compute, technical support and training to support innovation across industries.  Many of these companies are also members of the NVIDIA Inception program for cutting-edge startups — and as of today, access to some […]
items.content: The Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC)’s AI Factory Accelerator Programme, now in full operation following a pilot initiative, gives startups access to sovereign compute, technical support and training to support innovation across industries. Many of these companies are also members of the NVIDIA Inception program for cutting-edge startups — and as of today, access to some of the BSC AI Factory services are available through the NVIDIA Inception portal. NVIDIA Inception complements the BSC AI Factory Accelerator Programme by providing members with training through NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute open courses, business mentoring, venture capital connections and other resources. An upcoming extension of MareNostrum 5 — BSC’s public infrastructure serving scientific and technological innovation, powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing — will deliver supercomputing access through the BSC AI Factory and other AI Factories across Europe. BSC AI Factory is among Europe’s first AI factories and the first in Spain, and has delivered more than 800 services to private and public-sector clients since its April 2025 launch. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Three Inception members were recently named the BSC AI Factory Accelerator Programme’s AI Champions at the pilot initiative’s demo day: Qatium’s water-network platform — already used by more than 250 utilities in 16 countries — is now in early production with its Neural Water Intelligence technology, powered by proprietary AI models trained on MareNostrum 5. Built on NVIDIA accelerated computing, the NVIDIA cuGraph library, the NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo framework and NVIDIA Nemotron open models, the technology helps water utilities make better operational decisions every day. OneCareAI, a research spin-off from BSC, used NVIDIA NIM microservices to develop technology designed to identify signs of hidden atrial fibrillation — an irregular heart rhythm — in seemingly normal ECGs, helping clinicians identify patients who may be at risk of stroke before one occurs. Avatia built a voice-first, multi-agent system that provides pharmaceutical companies with agentic coworkers that support sales representatives and give doctors transparent, curated information about medicines, ultimately helping the right treatment reach the right patient sooner. The system taps into NVIDIA NIM microservices, the NVIDIA Nemotron 3 open model family and the open source NVIDIA NeMo Curator library. Other BSC AI Factory startups — Agrikola AI, Elna Health, Lokutor, Montevive AI, Oppy, Pack2Earth and Up2Smart — span precision agriculture, medical imaging and knowledge access, speech services, enterprise security, sales intelligence and sustainable packaging. The cohort reflects the breadth of what advanced intelligence can now unlock: preventing strokes, detecting breast cancer subtypes before biopsy, putting medical knowledge at doctors’ fingertips faster, replacing petroleum-based plastic with biobased compostable materials, protecting crops with robots instead of chemicals and more. items.titleZh: 西班牙初创企业携手巴塞罗那超级计算中心推动区域创新
items.descriptionZh:
巴塞罗那超级计算中心（BSC）的AI Factory Accelerator Programme在完成试点后已全面投入运营，为初创企业提供“主权算力”、技术支持和培训，以推动跨行业创新。该计划与NVIDIA面向前沿初创企业的Inception计划形成互补：许多BSC AI Factory成员同时也是NVIDIA Inception成员，即日起部分BSC AI Factory服务可通过NVIDIA Inception门户访问。NVIDIA Inception为成员提供NVIDIA深度学习学院公开课程、商业指导、风险投资对接等资源，从而降低初创企业使用欧洲公共超算和AI基础设施的门槛。

背景上，BSC AI Factory是欧洲首批AI工厂之一，也是西班牙首个AI工厂，自2025年4月启动以来已向私营和公共部门客户交付800多项服务。其算力基础MareNostrum 5是BSC面向科学技术创新的公共基础设施，由NVIDIA加速计算驱动；该系统的扩展将通过BSC AI Factory以及欧洲其他AI Factories提供超级计算访问能力。这意味着初创企业可以在欧洲本地公共算力底座上训练、部署和扩展AI应用，同时获得NVIDIA生态的技术与商业支持。

在试点演示日上，三家Inception成员被评为BSC AI Factory Accelerator Programme的“AI Champions”。Qatium的水网平台已被16个国家250多家公用事业公司使用，其Neural Water Intelligence技术进入早期生产阶段。该技术使用在MareNostrum 5上训练的专有AI模型，并基于NVIDIA加速计算、cuGraph图计算库、PhysicsNeMo物理与科学机器学习框架以及Nemotron开放模型，帮助水务公司改善日常运营决策。OneCareAI是BSC的研究衍生企业，利用NVIDIA NIM微服务开发技术，在看似正常的ECG中识别隐藏性心房颤动迹象，帮助临床医生在卒中发生前识别高风险患者。Avatia构建了语音优先的多智能体系统，为制药企业提供“代理同事”，支持销售代表并向医生提供透明、经过整理的信息，最终帮助正确治疗更快到达正确患者；该系统使用NVIDIA NIM微服务、Nemotron 3开放模型家族和开源NeMo Curator库。

其他BSC AI Factory初创企业包括Agrikola AI、Elna Health、Lokutor、Montevive AI、Oppy、Pack2Earth和Up2Smart，覆盖精准农业、医学影像与知识获取、语音服务、企业安全、销售智能和可持续包装等方向。这一批次体现了先进AI当前可解锁的应用广度：预防卒中、在活检前检测乳腺癌亚型、让医生更快获取医学知识、以生物基可堆肥材料替代石油基塑料、用机器人而非化学品保护作物等。整体来看，BSC AI Factory与NVIDIA Inception的衔接，将欧洲主权超算资源、NVIDIA加速计算与AI软件栈、初创培育和行业场景结合起来，形成从模型训练到微服务部署、再到行业落地的创新通道，加速AI在水务、医疗健康、制药、农业和可持续材料等领域的商业化。

items.content: CoreWeave had a bad week last week. Its bonds slipped into distressed territory by a common definition — when investors demand 1,000 basis points more in yield than they’d get from government bonds. Last Tuesday Chamath “SPAC King” Palihapitiya noticed the distressed debt, and also asked whether the AI buildout was a private credit bubble. Its shares are down more than 20 percent since Tuesday’s close, which is kind of a lot! There even seemed to be some collateral damage in the market on other AI companies, too.Now, I have also asked if the AI industry is a bubble, but when the SPAC King echoes concerns held by a lady whose ongoing question about AI is “How are we planning on affording this, champs?”, that’s a very different signal. When I say “yikes,” it’s one thing. When Elon Musk says it, that’s something else.When you talk about wanting to tap into the enormous sums of money that insurers have, that’s the kind of thing that makes investors afraid that CoreWeave is going to borrow even moreTo make things worse for CoreWeave, Brannin McBee, one of the company’s cofounders, told the Financial Times — also last week, on the same day as Palihapitiya’s post — that the company wants to have its debt be investment-grade, rather than junk, so that it can borrow from insurers, as their capital is, in his words, “unlimited.” This is not entirely unreasonable — earlier this year, CoreWeave secured its first investment-grade chip loan. But when you talk about wanting to tap into the enormous sums of money that insurers have, that’s the kind of thing that makes investors afraid that CoreWeave — already a massive debtor — is going to borrow even more.“The problem is not that credit profiles have changed in the last year, it’s that we’ve got another year and a half of supply coming,” Bloomberg quoted John Yovanovic, co-head of leveraged finance at MetLife Investment Management, as saying.I have seen people suggest that this means the AI bubble is bursting. I am not so sure. A plunging stock price is not necessarily financial doom. Stocks are an expression of confidence in a company’s future, not a reflection of day-to-day business. But CoreWeave has a lot of very expensive debt, and if that debt gets more expensive, that makes it even harder for CoreWeave to turn a profit.CoreWeave is the poster child for AI debt, and as of its second quarter earnings, owed more than $35 billion. That’s partly because it pioneered GPUs as collateral for loans, and partly because CoreWeave doesn’t have a real business beyond selling compute, a business on which it does not make money — the company lost more than a billion dollars in the first half of the year.The anxieties investors have around CoreWeave are, in fact, present for all neocloudsSo why am I not ready to do a victory lap on this? After all, I have suggested that this business is long-term unsustainable. The answer is “remaining performance obligations” from its customers — $103.7 billion of them as of the second quarter. About 40 percent of that money is due to CoreWeave in 2028, and the companies who’ve agreed to these contracts can’t cancel them except under some very limited circumstances. Its biggest customers are Microsoft, OpenAI, and what is probably Nvidia, though CoreWeave doesn’t disclose who its third-biggest customer is. Those three generated almost three-quarters of the company’s second quarter revenue.Microsoft and Nvidia are probably good for the money — at least, as long as it benefits them to be good for the money. (I suspect they realize that if CoreWeave goes belly-up, there will be plenty of collateral damage in the market, so they are unlikely to push the company over the edge themselves.) OpenAI is shakier, but unless OpenAI is in significantly more financial distress than we all realize, CoreWeave is probably fine for a while. As long as it can continue to pay off its debt, the music keeps going. Only when the AI boom falters are we going to find out if it’s actually a viable business.Still, the angst around CoreWeave has made things shaky for other companies that have taken out significant debt in the AI buildout — Oracle’s shares, for instance, which have fallen almost 10 percent in the same timeframe. There’s been a sell-off in Oracle bonds, too. The anxieties investors have around CoreWeave are, in fact, present for all neoclouds. It’s just not clear the bare-metal business is a good one.Anyway, some people are buying the dip.

items.titleZh: CoreWeave 的债务正成为整个人工智能行业的问题
items.descriptionZh:
CoreWeave上周经历了一个糟糕的星期。其债券按常见标准跌入“困境区间”，即投资者要求的收益率比政府债券高出1000个基点。上周二，被称为“SPAC之王”的Chamath Palihapitiya注意到其困境债务，并公开质疑AI基础设施建设是否正在形成私募信贷泡沫。自上周二收盘以来，CoreWeave股价已下跌超过20%，跌幅相当显著，市场上其他AI公司似乎也受到一定牵连。

文章作者表示，自己此前也质疑过AI行业是否存在泡沫，但当“SPAC之王”开始附和一位长期追问“我们到底打算怎么负担这一切”的人士的担忧时，这释放出的信号完全不同。换句话说，当作者说“情况不妙”是一种分量，当马斯克这样说则是另一种分量。

更令CoreWeave承压的是，公司联合创始人Brannin McBee上周在接受《金融时报》采访时、也就是Palihapitiya发帖同一天表示，CoreWeave希望其债务达到投资级而非垃圾级，从而能够向保险公司借款，因为在他看来保险公司的资金“无限”。这一想法并非完全没有道理：今年早些时候，CoreWeave获得了首笔投资级芯片贷款。但当公司谈论要动用保险公司的巨额资金时，投资者会担心，已经负债累累的CoreWeave将进一步举债。彭博社援引MetLife Investment Management杠杆融资联席主管John Yovanovic的话称，问题不在于过去一年信用状况发生变化，而在于未来一年半还有更多供应涌入。

有人据此认为AI泡沫正在破裂，但作者并不完全认同。股价暴跌不一定意味着财务末日；股票反映的是市场对公司未来的信心，而不是日常经营状况。但CoreWeave确实背负大量昂贵债务，如果债务成本进一步上升，其盈利难度会更大。CoreWeave是AI债务的典型代表，截至第二季度财报，公司负债超过350亿美元。这部分是因为它开创了以GPU作为贷款抵押品的融资模式，部分是因为CoreWeave除了出售算力之外并没有真正成型的业务，而这项业务并不赚钱——公司今年上半年亏损超过10亿美元。

不过，作者并不准备就此宣告CoreWeave失败。关键在于其客户的“剩余履约义务”：截至第二季度达1037亿美元，其中约40%将在2028年到期，签署合同的公司除极少数情况外不能取消。CoreWeave最大客户是微软、OpenAI，以及很可能是英伟达的第三大未披露客户；这三家客户贡献了公司第二季度近四分之三的收入。微软和英伟达大概率具备付款能力，至少在有利益的情况下如此；作者怀疑它们也意识到，如果CoreWeave破产，市场将遭受连带冲击，因此不太可能主动把公司推下悬崖。OpenAI的财务稳定性更弱，但除非其困境远比外界所知严重，否则CoreWeave短期内可能无虞。只要CoreWeave能继续偿还债务，音乐就会继续播放；只有AI繁荣放缓时，才能真正检验其商业模式是否可行。

尽管如此，围绕CoreWeave的焦虑已让其他在AI建设中背负大量债务的公司感到不稳。例如，甲骨文股价在同一时间段下跌近10%，其债券也出现抛售。投资者对CoreWeave的担忧实际上存在于所有“neocloud”公司之中；目前尚不清楚这种裸金属算力租赁业务是否是一门好生意。不过，仍有一些投资者在逢低买入。

history.title: AMD's FSR 4.1 now works on Radeon RX 6000 cards, Xbox Series X and S, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9, and Z2 SoCs
history.description: AMD has released a version of its cutting-edge FSR 4.1 upscaler that now works on Radeon RX 6000 GPUs, Xbox Series X and Series S consoles, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9, and Z2 chips.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Earlier this year, AMD brought the previously RX 9000-exclusive FSR 4 upscaling tech to Radeon RX 7000-series graphics cards and promised an early 2027 release for RX 6000-series products. Christmas has come early for RDNA 2 and many other Radeon gamers, as Radeon honcho Jack Hyunh has announced an FSR 4.1 release for Radeon RX 6000 series cards, Xbox Series X and Series S consoles, Ryzen Z-series handhelds, and machines with Ryzen AI Max and AI 9 chips today.To accomplish this feat, AMD says it tweaked FSR 4.1's neural network model to support the INT8 shader hardware (as opposed to the higher-precision FP8 matrix acceleration hardware on Radeon 9000 cards). Additionally, the version specific to handhelds is slimmed down even further, to less than half the size of the full one.AMD says that compared to FSR 3, games on the aforementioned GPUs and APUs will now deliver better image quality, all else equal. With Cyberpunk 2077 running in FSR Balanced mode at 4K, our quick testing with a Radeon RX 6900 XT shows that running FSR 4 costs just about 13% performance, a small price to pay for sharper and more stable visuals, especially in motion.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: And the higher upscaling quality of FSR 4.1 might let gamers use Performance mode where they might previously have used Balanced, or so on, which might offset that performance cost. AMD FSR™ Upscaling 4.1 for Desktop, Laptop, Handheld and Console - YouTube Watch On There are more goodies in store, too. The Radeon team says that FSR Frame Generation now ought to have better frame pacing, resolving a longstanding complaint with the tech and potentially making for smoother gameplay with framegen enabled. Support for the Vulkan API with FSR 4.1 is set to arrive at some point, as well, a boon for some games and console emulators. Finally, AMD says FSR Ray Regeneration will also be coming to more games, too. The company showed the tech running in Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, and that integration is available now. The updated software also adds support for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Star Wars: Galactic Racer, and Final Fantasy Resonance. history.titleZh: AMD FSR 4.1 现已支持 Radeon RX 6000 显卡、Xbox Series X 和
history.descriptionZh:
AMD 宣布将 FSR 4.1 超分辨率技术下放到更多现有硬件，覆盖 Radeon RX 6000 系列显卡、Xbox Series X/S 主机、Ryzen Z 系列掌机，以及搭载 Ryzen AI Max 和 AI 9 芯片的设备。此前 FSR 4 最初为 RX 9000 系列独占，今年早些时候才扩展到 RX 7000 系列，AMD 曾承诺 RX 6000 系列要到 2027 年初获得支持。如今这一时间表被大幅提前，对 RDNA 2 架构用户和大量 Radeon 游戏玩家而言是一次意外的“提前圣诞礼物”。

技术实现上，AMD 对 FSR 4.1 的神经网络模型进行了调整，使其能够运行在 INT8 着色器硬件上，而不是 RX 9000 系列所具备的更高精度 FP8 矩阵加速硬件。简单来说，INT8 和 FP8 都是低精度数值格式，前者在更广泛的旧硬件上具备更好的兼容性和执行效率，后者则在支持矩阵加速的新硬件上提供更高精度和吞吐能力。AMD 通过模型适配，让旧架构也能运行基于神经网络的 FSR 4.1。针对掌机设备，AMD 还提供了进一步精简的版本，其体积不到完整版的一半，以适应掌机在功耗、存储和算力上的限制。

性能方面，AMD 表示在同等条件下，上述 GPU 和 APU 上的游戏画面质量将优于 FSR 3。Tom's Hardware 使用 Radeon RX 6900 XT 在《赛博朋克 2077》4K 分辨率、FSR Balanced 模式下进行了快速测试，结果显示开启 FSR 4 大约带来 13% 的性能开销。对于更清晰、更稳定的画面，尤其是在运动场景中的表现而言，这一代价相对较小。并且，由于 FSR 4.1 的超分质量更高，玩家可能原本需要使用 Balanced 模式的场景，现在可以改用 Performance 模式，从而在一定程度上抵消性能开销。

除超分辨率外，FSR 4.1 还带来多项改进。AMD 表示 FSR Frame Generation 帧生成技术的帧节奏将得到改善，这有望解决该技术长期以来在帧生成平滑度方面的抱怨，使开启帧生成后的游戏体验更顺畅。FSR 4.1 还将增加对 Vulkan API 的支持，这对部分游戏和主机模拟器来说是有利消息。FSR Ray Regeneration 光线再生技术也将进入更多游戏，AMD 已在《战锤 40,000：暗潮》中展示该技术，相关集成目前已经可用。

用户可以通过 AMD Adrenalin 应用或 AMD 官网下载刚发布的 Radeon 26.10.1 驱动获得上述功能。该驱动还新增了对《使命召唤：现代战争 4》《星球大战：银河赛车》和《最终幻想 Resonance》的支持。对于 Xbox 和 Ryzen Z2 系列掌机用户，由于设备依赖 OEM 特定驱动，AMD 表示制造商将随后推送更新。

整体来看，这次更新让 Radeon 玩家能够为现有图形芯片获得类似 Nvidia 在 2025 年持续提供的功能升级。在全新游戏显卡发布节奏似乎仍较遥远的背景下，AMD 通过软件和神经网络模型适配延长了旧硬件的生命周期，也扩大了 FSR 4.1 的生态覆盖范围。对于 RDNA 2 用户而言，现在可以实际尝试 FSR 4 并评估画质与性能表现。

history.title: Mysterious AMD Zen 6 APU with 24GB of LPDDR5 memory appears in benchmarks
history.description: The engineering sample features six CPU cores, 24GB of LPDDR5 memory running at 9,600 MT/s, and an integrated GPU clocked at 2.4 GHz, although its connection to a future Steam Deck remains unconfirmed.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 6 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter An AMD engineering sample has made an appearance in a listing on OpenBenchmarking. According to a report by TechPowerUp, the chip could potentially be a part of AMD’s upcoming Gainsborough family and a possible candidate for the next-generation Steam Deck handheld console. As per the OpenBenchmarking listing, the chip comes with a six-core, 12-thread processor paired with 24GB of high-speed LPDDR5 memory.The engineering sample with part number 100-000001930-12_Y was tested on an AMD GBR-FF6-SKT validation board, with the CPU running at clock speeds of 2.4 GHz. The system also features four 6GB SK Hynix memory packages, resulting in 24GB of LPDDR5 memory running at 9,600 MT/s. That’s a big jump when compared to the current Steam Deck, which comes with 16GB of LPDDR5 memory running at 6,400 MT/s, alongside a four-core, eight-thread AMD Zen 2 processor. (Image credit: OpenBenchmarking)The benchmark listing also provides some clues about the processor’s underlying architecture. As per Notebookcheck, the sample’s CPU microcode revision corresponds to AMD’s Family 1Ah, model DCh. Linux kernel changes indicate that this model falls within the range reserved for newer Zen 6 processors, suggesting that Gainsborough could use AMD’s next-generation CPU architecture. However, there is no clarity or any confirmation whether it will use standard Zen 6 cores or the denser Zen 6C variant.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The integrated GPU is listed with a clock speed of 2,400 MHz, although its architecture and compute unit count remain unknown. The sample was tested using the GpuTest benchmark suite on Ubuntu 24.04 at 1024 x 768 resolution, resulting in scores of 3,871 in GiMark, 3,508 in FurMark, and 9,319 in TessMark. While the FurMark score is comparable to the original Stam Deck, we can’t really come to any conclusions at this point, as the tests were conducted on an engineering platform using development software rather than a finished handheld. For now, the results do not establish how the chip would perform in games, as power limits, cooling, driver maturity, and the final GPU configuration all contribute to the performance in a compact gaming device.If these specifications carry over to a future Steam Deck, the additional CPU cores along with the larger and faster memory would provide a meaningful hardware upgrade. That being said, neither AMD nor Valve have confirmed a connection between the Gainsborough family and a future Steam Deck. Thus, it is best to take this with a grain of salt and wait until there is more concrete information in the future. history.titleZh: 配备24GB LPDDR5内存的神秘AMD Zen 6 APU现身基准测试
history.descriptionZh:
近日，OpenBenchmarking 数据库中出现了一颗 AMD 工程样片，引发外界对其可能用于下一代 Steam Deck 的猜测。据 TechPowerUp 报道，该芯片可能属于 AMD 即将推出的 Gainsborough 家族，并被视为下一代 Steam Deck 掌机的潜在候选方案。不过，目前 AMD 和 Valve 均未确认 Gainsborough 与未来 Steam Deck 之间存在任何关联，因此相关消息仍应谨慎看待。

从 OpenBenchmarking 列表看，这颗工程样片编号为 100-000001930-12_Y，在 AMD GBR-FF6-SKT 验证板上测试，CPU 为 6 核 12 线程，运行频率 2.4GHz；系统配备 4 个 SK 海力士 6GB 内存封装，总计 24GB LPDDR5 内存，速率达 9600 MT/s。相比之下，现款 Steam Deck 采用 4 核 8 线程 AMD Zen 2 处理器和 16GB LPDDR5-6400 内存。也就是说，这颗样片在核心/线程数、内存容量和内存带宽上均比现款 Steam Deck 高出约 50%，若最终落地，将是明显的硬件升级，尤其有利于多线程负载、内存敏感型游戏以及集成 GPU 共享内存性能。

架构方面，报道指出该样片的 CPU 微码版本对应 AMD Family 1Ah、model DCh；结合 Linux 内核改动，该型号落在为更新一代 Zen 6 处理器预留的范围内，暗示 Gainsborough 可能采用 AMD 下一代 CPU 架构。但目前无法确认它使用的是标准 Zen 6 核心还是更注重面积效率的 Zen 6C 变体。集成 GPU 方面，列表显示其频率为 2400MHz，但架构和计算单元数量尚不清楚。该样片在 Ubuntu 24.04、1024×768 分辨率下运行 GpuTest，得到 GiMark 3871、FurMark 3508、TessMark 9319 的成绩；其中 FurMark 分数与初代 Steam Deck 相近，但由于测试基于工程平台和开发软件，而非最终掌机，且功耗限制、散热、驱动成熟度和最终 GPU 配置都会影响实际表现，目前还不能据此判断其游戏性能。

整体来看，如果这些规格最终延续到未来的 Steam Deck，更多 CPU 核心以及更大、更快的内存将带来有意义的硬件提升。但现阶段这仍只是工程样片和基准测试泄露，不能作为最终产品规格或性能结论，仍需等待 AMD、Valve 或更多可靠信息确认。

history.title: US restarts three shut-down nuclear reactors to feed AI data centers
history.description: The U.S. government is helping fund projects to bring nuclear reactors back online in an attempt to provide more energy capacity to AI data centers.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 13 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The current and expected power draw of AI data centers has been the subject of strong discussion, but today, there appears to be some good news. Three U.S. nuclear reactors are being restarted after many years offline, expected to bring 2.25 GW total to the grid. According to a report, the Palisades Nuclear Plant in Michigan, the Crane Clean Energy Center on Three Mile Island (Pennsylvania), and the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa are getting a fresh set of proverbial tires to get rolling again.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe Palisades plant was under active decommissioning, apparently marking this event as the first time a nuclear reactor is being put back to work after dismantling had begun. Despite what sounds like a tough starting point, this plant is the one that's furthest along, as it was loading fuel in August 2026 and is expected to generate 800 MW around March 2027.Much like the other projects mentioned here, the Holtec Palisades firm running the reactor took a loan from the U.S. Department of Energy. Palisades borrowed from the DoE under the Biden administration's 2024 investment in nuclear energy, while the others were issued under the purview of the Trump administration's 2025 push.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The second reactor is the Crane Clean Energy Center on Pennsylvania's Three Mile Island, repurposing the facility's Unit 1. The project started in 2024, with Constellation Energy saying it would spend $1.6 billion total for the reactor. The firm then took a $1 billion loan from the Department of Energy in 2025. Microsoft is set to be the main customer, with a 20-year contract. This facility is projected to bring 835 MW online sometime in 2027.This facility was famous in 1979 for the partial meltdown of its Unit 2, although mercifully the event had relatively tame environmental consequences. Constellation's ongoing project is restoring and refurbishing Unit 1, which didn't show significant issues until its 2019 decommissioning and has undergone a safety inspection from the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. This entity still needs to grant its blessing before the reactor starts loading fuel. You may like US AI data centers projected to become the fifth-largest natural gas consumer in the world by 2035 Startup plans to put nuclear-powered data centers in the sea OpenAI and Anthropic scramble for smaller data centers as massive gigawatt projects lag The Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa is the third unit being brought back to the grid, in a collaboration between NextEra Energy and Google. The predicted output is 615 MW, with the juice expected to start flowing in 2029. Next Energy CEO John Ketchum stated that the firm was happy with its cooperation contract with Google, as it meant that "none of the costs are being paid by residential customers in Iowa."All three facilities had previously been shut down at various points as they were deemed too expensive to run, as labor and maintenance costs made nuclear-generated watts pricier than alternative means of production.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsBut the financial landscape for power has shifted, plus with such overwhelming demand and grid connections being a primary blocker for data center buildouts, their operators are likely willing to pay for premium power as long as they get it now instead of in a few decades.Some quick browsing indicates that Michigan is going to need somewhere between 1.2 and 2.3 GW for data centers alone around 2030. Pennsylvania's forecast has a wide range of 0.8 to 3.4 GW, while Iowa's range is 1.55 to 2.8 GW. These figures are loose, as they include planned capacity for data center projects that may or may not end up being built, and whose timetables may slip due to economic conditions, hardware availability, and public resistance against expansive buildouts. history.titleZh: 美国重启三座已关闭的核反应堆，为AI数据中心供电
history.descriptionZh:
美国三座已停运多年的核反应堆正在推进重启，合计预计向电网新增约2.25 GW装机容量，为快速增长的AI数据中心提供稳定、无碳的基荷电力。三座机组分别是密歇根州Palisades核电站、宾夕法尼亚州三哩岛核电站的Crane Clean Energy Center（1号机组）以及艾奥瓦州Duane Arnold能源中心。它们此前均因劳动力与维护成本上升、核电出力价格高于替代电源而被关闭；如今电力需求激增、并网接入成为数据中心建设的主要瓶颈，加上电力市场融资环境变化，运营方和超大规模科技公司愿意以长期合同锁定“现在就能拿到”的稀缺电力，即使需要支付溢价。

从技术路径看，这些项目并非新建核电站，而是利用现有厂址、主设备、电网接入和部分许可基础进行翻新重启。核电机组通过受控核裂变产生热能，驱动蒸汽轮机发电，具有容量因子高、出力稳定、可24/7运行的特点，适合承担AI数据中心的基荷需求。其创新点主要体现在三方面：一是把“退役甚至已开始拆除”的核电机组重新投入运行；二是微软、Google等超大规模科技公司通过长期购电协议直接锁定核电出力；三是美国能源部通过贷款工具为重启项目提供融资支持。与新建核电项目相比，重启可显著缩短周期、降低部分建设成本，但仍需通过核监管委员会的安全审查和装料许可。

具体参数和进度方面，Palisades核电站由Holtec运营，装机预计800 MW，报道称其已于2026年8月装料，预计2027年3月左右发电；该项目在拆除工作已启动后重启，被视为首例此类实践，并获得拜登政府2024年核能投资框架下的美国能源部贷款。三哩岛1号机组项目由Constellation Energy推进，预计投资16亿美元，并获美国能源部10亿美元贷款，装机预计835 MW，计划2027年并网；微软是主要客户，签有20年合同。该厂2号机组曾在1979年发生部分堆芯熔毁事故，但环境影响相对有限；此次重启的是2019年退役前未出现重大问题的1号机组，仍需NRC批准后才能装料。Duane Arnold能源中心由NextEra Energy与Google合作，预计装机615 MW，计划2029年供电；NextEra首席执行官表示，与Google的合同意味着艾奥瓦州居民用户不承担相关成本。

从需求和影响看，这三座机组合计2.25 GW将部分缓解AI数据中心“有算力需求但缺电、缺并网”的矛盾，并为科技公司提供长期稳定的无碳电力来源，可能推动更多闲置核电机组评估重启。但报道也提示，数据中心需求预测本身区间较宽：密歇根州2030年仅数据中心需求预计1.2—2.3 GW，宾夕法尼亚州为0.8—3.4 GW，艾奥瓦州为1.55—2.8 GW；这些数字包含可能不会落地或进度延后的规划项目，受经济条件、硬件供应和公众对大规模建设阻力影响。总体而言，核电重启为AI基础设施供电提供了比新建核电更快的补充路径，但监管审批、成本控制和工期兑现仍是关键风险。

history.title: Oblivion gamer uses Claude AI to boost average FPS gains up to 48%, stutters slashed by 90%
history.description: The new Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix mod is a pure code fix, with no changes to game assets or the game's visuals, yet it offers massive gains.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 7 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The revelation that there was a ton of performance lying on the table in the remastered The Elder Scrolls Part IV: Oblivion won't be a surprise to people who have played the game, which is notorious for its hitching and stuttering. The reason primarily lies in its poor utilization of hardware, and that's a big part of what LTSharpe and Claude have addressed in the new Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix that changes nothing about the game's visuals yet increases performance by as much as 68% in the worst case. (h/t to ComputerBase)Yes, this mod is just about 100% vibe-coded, and yet, rather than hacking Minecraft into GTA V on iPhone, or hacking CoD Black Ops 2 maps into Minecraft, this mod is a binary code modification for Oblivion Remastered that seeks to improve performance and stability considerably, and according to numerous jubilant and thankful posts on NexusMods, it seems to do exactly that, with one user proclaiming that the performance increase was "dramatic" and that the overworld stuttering that plagues the game is "completely gone." (Image credit: LTSharpe on GitHub)The story goes like this: gamer and mod creator LTSharpe has a slightly older system with a Ryzen 7 5800X CPU. Not the newest chip on the block to be sure, but Zen 3 isn't so old that it should be crumpling under the weight of games just yet. Frustrated with the verifiably awful performance of the remaster of The Elder Scrolls Part IV: Oblivion, he paid for a subscription to Anthropic's Claude AI agent and started working with the assistant to diagnose and fix the performance problems.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: "Diagnose" is a critical keyword here, because it isn't like Claude was hallucinating an engine.ini tweak somebody else published for the original game 20 years ago. The partners, with Claude doing the hard work and LTSharpe directing, reverse-engineered the game to the point that they were able to build a repeatable benchmarking framework. That allowed them to systematically diagnose the causes of the performance problems and then test fixes against the real behavior of the game with modified machine code. Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix - YouTube Watch On That's the thing; this was done without source code. Neither TES4 Oblivion nor the remaster's Unreal Engine is open-source software. The sheer magnitude of the task would be incredibly daunting to a team of human engineers, much less a single person. According to LTSharpe, over the course of two weeks Claude successfully diagnosed and fixed bugs in not only the Remaster's Unreal Engine code, but also in the underlying Gamebryo original engine, in AMD's frame generation code, and even in the Unreal Engine itself, improving performance and avoiding crashes. Indeed, he has a Radeon graphics card, which puts him within a surprisingly small minority of PC gamers, and some portion of his fixes were aimed at making sure AMD's FSR upscaling and frame generation remain in effect despite a long-standing game bug that disables them when you task-switch (Alt+Tab) out of the game. The good lieutenant invites other gamers to try out the fix and report back, and he's even helping out with support requests on NexusMods, too. Head over there if you're keen to grab the fix and try it for yourself. history.titleZh: 《湮灭》玩家用Claude AI提升平均FPS高达48%，卡顿减少90%
history.descriptionZh:
近日，围绕《上古卷轴4：湮灭重制版》性能问题出现了一个颇具代表性的AI辅助改造案例。该重制版因卡顿、掉帧和画面停顿而饱受玩家诟病，核心原因被认为是游戏对硬件利用不佳。模组作者LTSharpe借助Anthropic的Claude AI代理，发布了“Oblivion Remastered Performance Fix”。该修复不改变游戏画面，却在最坏情况下带来最高约68%的性能提升。NexusMods上不少用户反馈提升“非常显著”，困扰游戏的开放世界卡顿“完全消失”。

这一项目的关键不在于常见的引擎配置文件调整，而是对游戏二进制代码进行修改。LTSharpe使用较老的Ryzen 7 5800X平台，因重制版性能糟糕而订阅Claude，并在其辅助下对游戏进行逆向工程。二者先建立可重复的基准测试框架，再系统诊断性能瓶颈，并用修改后的机器码针对真实运行行为验证修复效果。由于《湮灭》原版和重制版所用虚幻引擎均非开源软件，这项工作是在没有源代码的条件下完成的，难度远高于普通模组开发。据LTSharpe介绍，Claude在约两周内诊断并修复了重制版虚幻引擎代码、底层Gamebryo原引擎、AMD帧生成代码以及虚幻引擎本身的多处问题，从而提升性能并避免崩溃。

性能对比方面，该修复的重点是消除卡顿和提升稳定性，而非替换画质资源；其“最坏情况提升68%”表明原版存在大量未被利用的性能空间。新闻也指出，该模组被调侃为“几乎100%氛围编码”，即高度依赖AI辅助生成和修改，但它并非简单幻觉式调参，而是建立在逆向分析、基准测试和机器码修补之上的工程实践。

技术影响上，这一案例展示了AI代理在无源码软件逆向、性能诊断和二进制修补中的潜力：它可帮助个人开发者在传统上需要团队投入的领域快速定位问题，并为游戏模组社区提供新的优化路径。应用场景包括老游戏/重制版性能修复、AMD平台帧生成与FSR稳定性改善、Alt+Tab切换后超分和帧生成失效等长期bug的规避，以及无源码条件下的兼容性修复。不过，作者也强调，这些修改主要针对其本人系统，尤其是Radeon显卡环境，其他玩家可能效果不同；部分修复还专门确保AMD FSR超分和帧生成在Alt+Tab后继续生效。作者正在NexusMods上邀请玩家测试并反馈，同时提供支持。总体而言，该案例既说明重制版存在显著优化空间，也显示AI辅助逆向工程和机器码级修复正在降低高性能补丁的开发门槛，但其通用性、稳定性和社区验证仍待进一步观察。

history.title: China’s tech giants drop $35 billion on export-compliant Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 workstation GPU orders to power AI ambitions, according to reports
history.description: $35 billion worth of Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 GPUs have been bought by Chinese trio Tencent, Alibaba and ByteDance, with demand far exceeding Nvidia's planned production, according to report.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Chinese technology giants ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have reportedly spent over $35 billion on orders for more than 3 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 workstation GPUs. The huge order for the RTX Pro 5500, fully compliant with U.S. restrictions on exports of AI-capable GPUs to China, is reportedly far beyond Nvidia's planned production for this card. As a result, Nvidia has, according to sources who spoke to Reuters, told its customers that it isn't in a position to fill the orders as it far outstrips its planned production for this GPU.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe RTX Pro 5500 is a workstation GPU with the same number of CUDA cores as its flagship RTX 5090 GPU, but with 84GB of GDDR7 memory attached, making it a good option for AI applications. The RTX Pro 5500 is a popular choice at the moment for Chinese buyers as exporting it isn't currently restricted by the U.S. government. It's less powerful than the H200 and B300, Nvidia's AI-focused GPUs for the enterprise market, but those GPUs remain either banned or heavily restricted. As China competes with the U.S. in the race to produce newer, better AI models, GPUs like the RTX Pro 5500 continue to be indispensable.The report reveals some interesting data about the Chinese tech firms orders. Two of its sources revealed that the cards are priced at around $11,400 each, reaching a total order value of $35 billion. Meanwhile, another source suggested that Nvidia has informed its partners that it may only be able to deliver enough cards to meet between 5% and 10% of the demand. Meanwhile, Nvidia is reportedly in a position to only produce 3 million RTX Pro 5500 cards globally in 2027.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Neither Nvidia nor the three Chinese companies have confirmed any of this on the record. However, an Nvidia spokesman told Reuters that demand from the Chinese market for these chips has faced "unprecedented growth since 2022" since export restrictions were introduced. "U.S. firms continue to be restricted by a combination of outdated U.S. export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly half a decade ago, and China's own limits on U.S. imports."While trade hostility between the U.S. and China shows no sign of abating, demand for Nvidia's GPUs hasn't slowed down, despite U.S. attempts to restrict Nvidia's ability to export to China. Meanwhile, export-restricted Nvidia AI chips continue to reach China despite the restrictions, bypassing the Trump administration's efforts in the process. history.titleZh: 据报，中国科技巨头斥资350亿美元订购符合出口合规要求的英伟达RTX Pro 5500工作站GPU，以助力其AI雄心
history.descriptionZh:
据Tom's Hardware援引路透社报道，字节跳动、阿里巴巴和腾讯三家中国科技巨头据称已向英伟达下达超过300万颗RTX Pro 5500工作站GPU的订单，总价值超过350亿美元。消息人士称，这一订单规模远超英伟达对该型号的既定产量，英伟达已告知客户无法按需交付，可能仅能满足其中5%至10%的需求。报道同时指出，英伟达2027年全球RTX Pro 5500产量计划约为300万颗，而中国三家公司的单笔订单就已超过这一数量。英伟达和上述三家公司均未正式确认相关消息。

背景方面，美国自2022年起对可用于AI的高性能GPU实施对华出口限制，导致英伟达面向企业市场的H200、B300等AI加速卡在中国市场要么被禁止出口，要么受到严格限制。RTX Pro 5500目前不在美国对华AI GPU出口限制范围内，因此成为中国企业获取AI算力的重要合规替代选择。英伟达发言人对路透社表示，自2022年出口限制出台以来，中国市场对这些芯片的需求出现“前所未有的增长”，并称美国企业仍受制于过时的美国出口管制——其中甚至涵盖近五年前发布的游戏产品——以及中国对美国进口产品的限制。

从技术角度看，RTX Pro 5500是一款工作站GPU，其CUDA核心数量与旗舰级RTX 5090相同，但配备84GB GDDR7显存。大容量显存使其在AI应用中具有较强吸引力，可用于承载更大模型、减少模型切分和显存卸载带来的开销，并提升推理、微调及AI开发工作流的效率。其绝对性能低于英伟达面向企业市场的H200和B300，但在后两者对华供应受限的背景下，RTX Pro 5500成为可合规采购且显存容量突出的现实选择。报道称，该卡单价约为1.14万美元，按此计算，300万颗订单总价约为350亿美元。

这一订单反映出中国AI产业在美国出口管制下对英伟达GPU的强劲需求，以及合规工作站GPU在AI训练、推理、模型微调和开发部署中的实际价值。与此同时，巨大的订单量与英伟达有限产能之间的矛盾，意味着中国企业可能面临交付周期长、供应不足等问题，也可能推高相关硬件价格或刺激其他替代方案。报道还提到，尽管美国试图限制英伟达对华出口，受出口限制的英伟达AI芯片仍持续通过不同渠道进入中国，绕过相关政策限制。整体来看，该事件凸显了中美科技竞争背景下AI算力供应链的紧张态势，以及出口管制对产品选择、产能分配和市场需求的深刻影响。

history.title: Modal taps Nvidia Vera CPUs after firm's internal tests show 2x throughput over Intel and AMD chips
history.description: Nvidia's Vera CPU delivers twice the performance of Intel and AMD chips in AI agent workloads, Modal claims.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia has earned billions selling AI accelerators, but with the emergence of agentic AI, CPUs are going to play a considerably more significant role than before, which creates new opportunities for the company. Reuters reports that Nvidia has secured a major design win with its Vera CPUs with AI cloud provider Modal. According to Modal, preliminary evaluations showed that Vera could deliver twice the throughput of its existing AMD and Intel processors, although the company does not intend to cease using CPUs from its current suppliers.Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Intel VP Robert Hallock sets Nova Lake expectations, teases return to Raptor Lake for DDR4 platformsCPU scaling with DLSSIntel's one-two punch plan in desktop CPUs is taking shapeBenchmarking AMD's BC-250, offering Steam Machine-like performance at half the priceAMD splits Zen 7 into three EPYC families for 2028 and starts selling server CPUs by the agent Modal provides cloud infrastructure that enables AI developers to deploy AI agents that can perform complex operations autonomously over extended periods. Such workloads require substantial CPU resources for software execution, data processing, and other tasks that cannot be efficiently handled by GPUs. Modal currently relies exclusively on AMD and Intel processors for these operations, but its tests indicate that Nvidia's new Vera CPUs could significantly improve performance in its specific workloads. Of course, since Vera is based on an Arm instruction set architecture, Modal's decision to adopt Vera will require substantial modifications to its software. Nevertheless, Modal believes that the potential performance improvements justify the additional engineering effort.The reported 2x throughput advantage is particularly interesting because agentic AI workloads can involve numerous independent tasks that compete for CPU cores, cache capacity, and memory bandwidth. However, Modal has not disclosed detailed benchmark configurations it used, specific AMD and Intel processor models, or performance-per-watt figures. Consequently, it remains unclear whether Vera's advantage is enabled by advantages of its Arm v9.2-based Olympus CPU cores that can decode and execute up to 10 instructions per cycle, its memory subsystem with 1.2 TB/s of bandwidth, or other architectural characteristics. Also note that tests compared Vera against currently available AMD and Intel processors rather than their upcoming generations that will compete against Vera in the coming years.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Since Modal cannot port all of its software to Arm ISA overnight, the company will continue using x86 CPUs from AMD and Intel, according to Modal chief executive Erik Bernhardsson. Rather than sticking to one ISA for everything, Modal intends to operate a heterogeneous server fleet and select the most suitable processors for each workload. Naturally, the company intends to evaluate upcoming AMD and Intel processors once they become available to make its choices in the future.For Nvidia, the agreement represents a major step toward making Vera a standalone server processor that commands a major share of the server market. The company expects Vera sales to generate at least $20 billion during its current fiscal year and estimates the potential total available market for these CPUs is approximately $200 billion. The company is on track to sell at least four million Vera CPUs in fiscal 2026.
